string.name: desc
string.value: Deflect all abnormal status effects. The shell breaks and must cooldown after a certain number of deflected status effects. Passively increases resistance to all elemental and abnormal status effects.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon. Ignore abnormal status #3 times. Cooldown: #cooltime sec when broken.\n[Passive effect: Increase resistance to all elemental and abnormal status effects by #terR%]
